subject: general
question: Which of the following is a standard internet protocol used for transmitting the files from one computer to another computer connected to the internet?
solution:
The correct answer is __**FTP.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **FTP** stands for** File Transfer Protocol.**
 
• It is a** network protocol** for **transmitting files between computers over Transmission Control Protocol/Internet Protocol (TCP/IP) connections.**
 
• It is considered an** application layer protocol.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__****SMTP**

 
• It stands for **Simple Mail Transfer Protocol.**
 
• It is a TCP/IP protocol **used in sending and receiving e-mail.**

**TELNET**

 
• It stands for **TELecommunication NETwork​.**
 
• Its utility allows users t**o test connectivity to remote machines and issue commands through the use of a keyboard.**

**HTTP**

 
• It stands for **HyperText Transfer Protocol.**
 
• A protocol for **fetching resources **such as HTML documents.
